verdict.rationale: The 01 docs say they offer guides for assembling your own 01 device, covering hardware configurations from desktop setups to ESP32-based portable builds. The repo ships an ESP32 client implementation and a Light Server built for ESP32, so first-party build guidance exists, but its end-to-end depth is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit bill of materials, wiring diagrams, and documented firmware flashing steps, plus hands-on corroboration that a build can be followed end to end.
